ops.note: Insertion sort grows a sorted run at the left, one item at a time. A single item is already a sorted run of one.

ops.caption: Take the next item, 2, and compare it with 7, the end of the sorted run.
2 is smaller than 7, so it swaps left. The sorted run is now [2, 7].

ops.note: 2 has nothing left of it to compare against, so it stops here.

ops.caption: Take the next item, 9, and compare it with 7, the end of the sorted run.

ops.note: 9 is not smaller than 7, so it does not move. It stops immediately: the sorted run just grows to [2, 7, 9].

ops.caption: Take the next item, 4, and compare it with 9.
4 is smaller than 9, so it swaps left.
4 is smaller than 7 too, so it swaps left again.
Now compare 4 with 2, the first item of the sorted run.

ops.note: 4 is not smaller than 2, so it stops here. The sorted run is now [2, 4, 7, 9].

ops.caption: Take the last item, 1, and compare it with 9.
1 is smaller than 9, so it swaps left.
1 is smaller than 7, so it swaps left again.
1 is smaller than 4, so it swaps left again.
Compare 1 with 2, the last item standing between it and the front.
1 is smaller than everything else, so it swaps all the way to the front.

ops.note: 1 stops only at the very front, because it is smaller than every item in the sorted run.

ops.caption: The sorted run now covers the whole array: 1, 2, 4, 7, 9.
